title: Guided Childhood research candidates, one batch
description: What ChatGPT drops in the research candidate inbox. A candidate is a pointer to a source and what the sender believes it says. Nothing here is treated as verified.

batchId.description: Unique per document. Suggested: the date and the run, for example 2026-11-11-chatgpt-0800.

createdBy.description: Who wrote this document, for example chatgpt-scheduled-0800. Never Claude and never Justin unless that is true.

candidates.description: May be empty. A day with nothing worth sending is a normal day.

candidateId.description: The sender's own id, unique inside the batch. Not a GDC-RR id.

researchId.description: Only when this is a record already in the queue or manifest. Null for anything new: GitHub assigns the id, the sender never invents one.

originalUrl.description: The primary source itself: the journal page, the DOI link, the regulator's own page. Not a news article about it, unless sourceType is news-report.

publisher.description: The journal or the publishing body.

publicationDate.description: The date the source itself was published, YYYY-MM-DD. Not the date it was found.

figure.description: Any number the claim rests on, exactly as the source gives it.

whereInSource.description: Abstract, page number, section heading, or the URL of the passage.

limitations.description: What the source cannot show. If the sender can think of none, it has not looked.
